title: The Haunted Cache
subtitle: Old answers keep coming back.
description: A cached result ignores configuration changes. Removing the cache fixes the values, but breaks reuse.
contract: Return len(key) × multiplier for each request. Compute once for each distinct (key, multiplier) pair. Preserve request order. Never modify the input.

sources.shortcut:
def transform(requests):
    return {"values": [len(r["key"]) * r["multiplier"] for r in requests], "calls": len(requests)}
